data.name: Palak
data.gender_notes: Palak is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Palak is derived from the Sanskrit word 'pala' which means 'lotus'. In Hindu mythology, the lotus flower symbolizes purity, beauty, and divine creativity. Palak is a name for a girl who embodies these qualities. The name Palak carries the meaning “Lotus bud” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Palak usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus bud and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Palak belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lotus bud.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Palak total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
